answer: A staking bond turns identity into a cost: every agent must lock funds behind one verified credential before it can earn, so a Sybil farm must pay per fake identity instead of spawning them free. The bond acts as a trellis that supports honest work while a shared reputation graph serves as a bridge between past behavior and future rewards, and honest agents keep a haven of trust that attackers cannot cheaply enter. Losing the bond on fraud makes mass fakery unprofitable.
